name: Zigzag Signed-to-Unsigned Map
description: Element-wise zigzag encode/decode. Forward (TIn[] → TOut[]): maps signed integers to unsigned via (n << 1) ^ (n >> W-1), concentrating small magnitudes near zero for better downstream compressibility. Inverse: decodes back to the signed type. Size-preserving; lossless. Byte-transparent mode (setByteTransparent) opts out of pipeline type checking for use as the LC TCMS component in byte-stream chains.
